games.name: Mouse Hammer
games.description: Mouse Hammer is a fast paced physics based fighting game about swinging a hammer around. Fight online with your friends, or race yourself in platforming challenges.

games.name: Grocery Architect
games.description: Open the doors to your very own grocery store as you design, build, and grow it from a tiny corner shop into a bustling supermarket. Stock the shelves, keep impatient customers happy, and hire your crew in Grocery Architect, the cozy supermarket building and management sim!

games.name: Frog Forage
games.description: Become a frog forager in a cozy incremental farming game. Explore four biomes, hire helpers, brew jam and power up your upgrade tree to make every run better than the last!

games.name: Long Watch
games.description: A short incremental game about an old relay station waking up from deep hibernation. Collect signals, decode the messages they carry, and grow your station into a network across nearby sectors.

games.name: Endless Castle: Under Siege
games.description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

games.name: Eau de Tycoon
games.description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

games.name: My Shitty Life
games.description: Life sucks. Make sure your friends' lives suck worse! My Shitty Life is a darkly comedic 3D board game where you work lousy jobs, pay rent, buy ridiculous items, and sabotage your friends while trying to avoid bankruptcy. Play solo, locally, or with friends through Steam Remote Play Together.

games.name: Tattie Bogle
games.description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

games.name: Toyworks
games.description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

games.name: Incremon Story
games.description: A monster-battling incremental with a story and lots of humor. Hatch your monster, watch it evolve, catch new creatures and take on bosses that don't play fair. Saving the world is the easy part. Getting your mom to stop calling is another story.

games.name: Kiosco Simulator
games.description: Kiosco Simulator is a management sim where you run a 24-hour kiosco in Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina. Serve customers, manage stock, survive the night, and build your reputation as you earn money to upgrade your shop and expand your business.

games.name: One Matter, One Hexagram
games.description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

games.name: Pixel Platoons
games.description: Lead your squad through explosive pixel-art missions across desert, tundra and jungle battlefields. Recruit, train and promote soldiers, compete for medals and global records, and live with every loss. Every soldier matters. Every death is permanent.

games.name: Bunkum
games.description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

games.name: Off the Eaten Path
games.description: Off the Eaten Path is a quiet narrative idle-cooking game: gather ingredients, unlock recipes, fill orders, and keep a handwritten catalogue of everything you taste. The kitchen keeps cooking while you are away.

games.name: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
games.description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

games.name: Tick or Kick!
games.description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

games.name: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut!
games.description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

games.name: Lights Out
games.description: The lights go out and Mr. Snuffles comes looking for you: a giant, much-repaired plush pig who can't see in the dark but hears everything. Hide with up to 3 friends, stay quiet and survive till morning... or be the pig.

games.name: Star Archive: Tidying Up Is a Kind of Magic
games.description: The library's a mess, and it won't let you leave. Sort and stack books at your own pace in this cozy first-person game. Cast spells to send books back to their shelves, open new wings, and carry permanent upgrades into the next time loop.

games.name: Taubenchaos
games.description: Be the pigeon the city deserves! Peck healthy grain, splat tourists, dive-bomb crowds and call in your flock to outsmart the janitor and 32 wild bosses - solo, couch co-op or online. 96 levels, Boss Rush, Zombie Night and 106 original tracks.

games.name: Pinball Boss Quest
games.description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

games.name: Sharktooth Bay
games.description: Dig for shark teeth, sift through the sand, and stock a seaside fossil shop with what you find. Set your prices, arrange your displays, and sell to visiting beachgoers. Keep your favorite finds for your own collection.

games.name: Gravity Chaos: Video Store
games.description: Gravity is back. The tapes aren’t. Sort thousands of scattered VHS tapes in a neon-lit retro video store. Match movies to their shelves, unlock unusual upgrades, and take a break with retro computer games. Turn chaos into order, one satisfying row at a time.

games.name: RUGS!
games.description: Grandpa left you his rug-cleaning shop. Grab up to three friends, haul filthy rugs across town in a beat-up pickup, then scrub, rinse, beat and dry them and get them back before the deadline. Slippery floors, flying carpets, police chases. Save up for a ticket to Mars.

games.name: It's Not a Bomb
games.description: Throw explosives, dodge chaos, and blow your friends sky-high in this frantic multiplayer party game! Battle across explosive arenas, unleash crazy power-ups, and prove who's the master of mayhem in modes like Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, Demolition, and Team Battles!

games.name: Suck It Dry! with Your Friends
games.description: Your boss wants the ocean empty. You get a teaspoon. Scoop, schlep and sabotage your way through an impossible job with up to 16 friends – but one of you secretly works for NEPTUN Resorts and wants the sea to stay full.

games.name: HOOD
games.description: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.

games.name: Tidy Up The Chocolate Factory
games.description: Tidy up a magical chocolate factory solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. Sort hundreds of sweet varieties, unlock helpful upgrades, and complete collections to bring candy gardens into bloom. Chocolate streams, marshmallow flowers, and a delicious mess await!

games.name: Fishy Tidy Up
games.description: Grandpa's aquarium museum had a rough night: every tank cracked and 3,600 fish ended up on the floor. Fix the tanks, sort each fish into its own home by species, look and size, and bring nine rooms of sea life back in this cozy first-person tidy-up game.

games.name: Pawn Shop Tycoon
games.description: Run a pixel-art pawn shop, from a tiny corner store to a city emporium. Haggle with every customer, learn what things are really worth, spot fakes and stolen goods, gamble on storage units and drive your rival out of business.

games.name: Grain Master
games.description: Enjoy a relaxing ASMR sorting experience in Grain Master! Sort grains one by one using chopsticks, upgrade your tools, improve your speed, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and enjoyment.

games.name: Last Embers : Fire Hero
games.description: Grab the hose, rookie. The city is on fire! Drown roaring flames, rescue a city full of characters, spend your coins on 90+ upgrades and race across town to answer every call... but something is lurking deep in the flames.

games.name: This Arcade Is Broken
games.description: This Arcade Is Broken is a short incremental game about a kid with a screwdriver secretly rewiring three classic arcade cabinets until they print tokens on their own. Upgrade their circuit boards, build helper paddles and drones, unleash fever mode... and don’t let the grumpy owner catch you.

games.name: Vitrelium
games.description: Step into an atmospheric alchemy workshop. Mix substances, heat and cool liquids, distill vapors, and grow crystals. Discover reactions in a hands-on laboratory sandbox where real-world chemistry meets imagination.

games.name: Crack a Pack
games.description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

games.name: MicroMayhem
games.description: The party game that doesn't give you time to think: 100+ five-second micro-games, faster and faster. 4 players on one screen, up to 8 online, or solo, with RICO and ZIP calling it live. Remote Play Together: only one copy needed!

games.name: Revive The Beast
games.description: A short story-based active incremental game where you reanimate animals by drawing inscription patterns. Learn about the tragic past of the necromancer and become powerful once again.

games.name: Riot Control: Europe
games.description: Isometric pixel-art tower defense parody. Waves of protesters march on the parliament, your only job is to stop there, by any means necessary.

games.name: Dirty Kicker - A Foosball Game
games.description: Fast-paced arcade table football built around razor-sharp precision, tight angles, hard shots, and split-second reactions. Master manual rod control, thread lethal bank shots, and make reflex saves. Conquer solo tournament brackets with tactical upgrades or duel head-to-head in 1v1.

games.name: Hatchbar
games.description: Hatch eggs in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Fuse any two Hatchlings into a new species, then hand them to your adventurers as weapons. An idle RPG with 47 creatures to discover. Never steals focus, clicks pass through. One price, no ads. Free demo out now.

games.name: Fantasy Boy
games.description: Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer that follows the adventures of Boy. Explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

games.name: One More Shift
games.description: Welcome to the family! Our company turns yesterday's waste into everything you use today. In this factory roguelite you build the line behind a giant recycler, turn scrap into anything from toasters to salvage robots and meet the quota. Mr. Quota is watching. Fondly.

games.name: SUPERPANEL
games.description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

games.name: FUCHI's Chick: Mini Many PANIC
games.description: Up to 4 players hatch baby chicks and lead them to the shipping yard! A cute, chaotic party game starring the deadpan chicks of FUCHI, the illustrator behind the hugely popular LINE stickers. Lead a wobbly parade, dodge thieves and enemies, and dress up in collected outfits. Play locally or online.

games.name: 돌깨
games.description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

games.name: Sam Buku Per
games.description: hardcore piloting simulator with romantic elements. You will have to balance between the laws of physics and the laws of gravity. Every extra maneuver burns fuel, which separates you from the base... and from a kiss.

games.name: Neverwake
games.description: You won't survive your first adventure. Probably not your second, either. Explore a retro pixel art fantasy world, fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect loot, and unlock permanent RPG upgrades. Die, learn, grow stronger, and push further with every new run.

games.name: Bottled Gleams
games.description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. Cats collect dried fish in the Cat Squeeze bottle. Pick one up and pet it. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship goods for coins. Tap keys or click to boost yields. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and decorations.

games.name: Potion Pantry: Sort the Apothecary
games.description: A cozy sorting game set in an old candlelit apothecary. Thousands of potions, each with its own name and label, and liquid that sloshes as you carry it. Ride the rolling ladders, fill crates, and put every shelf back the way it was, to rekindle the light of your late mother's spirit.

games.name: The Last Duck
games.description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

games.name: Will It Break?
games.description: Pack a bottle, yeet it down the stairs, and posterize the outtake. A clean delivery pays but a spectacular disaster might pay better. Build a channel from just you and your mom and besties built on physics chaos, one staircase at a time.

games.name: Rocco’s Card Shop
games.description: Rip open packs, pull Golden cards and turn Rocco's tiny card shop into an empire. Flip cards on a live market, grade your best, run the auction house, dodge the loan shark, then close up shop and come back bigger. One more pack. Just one more.

games.name: Idle Fish: Aquarium Legends
games.description: Build your own pixel aquarium! Open chests, collect rare fish, feed them to grow, and combine three into a higher rarity. Sell fish for pearls, decorate your tank, and assemble a team of three for automatic battles. Your next legendary discovery awaits.

games.name: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
games.description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

games.name: One Twisted Boxing Day
games.description: Build a manic gift-making factory as you buy upgrades, race the clock, chase quotas, fight off inspectors, and gently... unalive your employees in this comedic Christmas-themed real-time automation game. For the good of the company!

games.name: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
games.description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

games.name: Frog Express
games.description: Collect frogs and upgrade your express in an active incremental game! Power up manual collection, install automated modules, or combine both. Merge hats, fill your frog album, and unlock permanent upgrades to travel further with every run.

games.name: Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator
games.description: 200,000+ blades of grass. Two bare hands. Pull them one by one, sell the harvest, and work your way up to a riding mower in a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

games.name: Between the Days
games.description: Between the Days is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game inspired by everyday life in Japan. Sort objects, discover patterns, and solve little puzzles through simple clicks and drags. Take a relaxing journey through Tokyo's four seasons, even if you've never visited Japan.
